properties.definition: Subject term(s) describing a resource.
properties.label: Subject
properties.name: subject

properties.definition: Relates a subject to that which it describes.
properties.label: Subject of
properties.name: subjectOf

properties.definition: Specific place within the holding entity where the item is located or made available.
properties.label: Held in sublocation
properties.name: sublocation

properties.definition: Subseries enumeration of the resource; usually transcribed.
properties.label: Subseries enumeration
properties.name: subseriesEnumeration

properties.definition: Relation between a Series resource and the resources it encompasses, forming a Subseries; the Series resource itself has a relation with a larger resource, of which it is a part
properties.label: Subseries of
properties.name: subseriesOf

properties.definition: Statement of the subseries the resource is in; usually transcribed; includes the ISSN if applicable.
properties.label: Subseries statement
properties.name: subseriesStatement

properties.definition: Word, character, or group of words and/or characters that contains the remainder of the title after the main title. Possible title component.
properties.label: Subtitle
properties.name: subtitle

properties.definition: Resource that succeeds the resource being described, e.g., later in time or after in a narrative
properties.label: Succeeded by
properties.name: succeededBy

properties.definition: Summary or abstract of the resource described.
properties.label: Summary content
properties.name: summary

properties.definition: Resource that updates or otherwise complements the predominant resource
properties.label: Supplement
properties.name: supplement

properties.definition: Resource that is updated or otherwise complemented by the augmenting resource
properties.label: Supplement to
properties.name: supplementTo

properties.definition: Material such as an index, bibliography, appendix intended to supplement the primary content of a resource.
properties.label: Supplementary material
properties.name: supplementaryContent

properties.definition: Equipment or system requirement beyond what is normal and obvious for the type of carrier or type of file, such as make and model of equipment or hardware, operating system, amount of memory, programming language, other necessary software, any plug-ins or peripherals required to play, view, or run the resource, etc.
properties.label: Equipment or system requirements
properties.name: systemRequirement

properties.definition: Number of the table from which the classification number in a subdivision entry is taken, e.g., a DDC table.
properties.label: Classification table identification
properties.name: table

properties.definition: Table of contents of the described resource.
properties.label: Table of contents content
properties.name: tableOfContents

properties.definition: Sequence number or other identifier for an internal classification sub arrangement or add in a classification scheme.
properties.label: Classification table sequence number
properties.name: tableSeq

properties.definition: Relates a work to a music tempo
properties.label: Tempo
properties.name: tempo

properties.definition: Time period coverage of the content of the resource.
properties.label: Temporal coverage
properties.name: temporalCoverage

properties.definition: Name given to a resource.
properties.label: Title resource
properties.name: title

properties.definition: Relates a title resource to that which it is the title of.
properties.label: Title of
properties.name: titleOf

properties.definition: Resource that translates the text of the source entity into a language different from that of the original
properties.label: Translation as
properties.name: translation

properties.definition: Resource that has been translated, i.e., the text is expressed in a language different from that of the original resource
properties.label: Translation of
properties.name: translationOf

properties.definition: Units in which a value is expressed, such as the physical or logical constituent of a resource (e.g., a volume, audiocassette, film reel, a map, a digital file).
properties.label: Type of unit
properties.name: unit

properties.definition: General statement of allowances and restrictions on access to a resource, including retention, reproduction, access, and lending.
properties.label: Use and access condition
properties.name: usageAndAccessPolicy

properties.definition: The medium of performance used by a contributing agent
properties.label: Uses medium of performance
properties.name: usesMediumOfPerformance

properties.definition: The date or date range during which the resource is accurate.
properties.label: Valid date
properties.name: validDate

properties.definition: Type of title variation, e.g., acronym, cover, spine, earlier, later, series version.
properties.label: Variant title type
properties.name: variantType

properties.definition: Term or terms that identify works such as arranged for music, vulgate for religious work, etc.
properties.label: Version
properties.name: version

properties.definition: Technical specification relating to the encoding of video images in a resource
properties.label: Video characteristic
properties.name: videoCharacteristic

properties.definition: Voice for which a musical work is appropriate, such as soprano, tenor, mixed.
properties.label: Voice
properties.name: voice

properties.definition: Specific type of voice group, such as chorus, solo.
properties.label: Type of voice
properties.name: voiceType
